answer.question: What is ecommerce SEO?
answer.text: Ecommerce SEO is the process of improving an online store's visibility in search engines so more shoppers find and buy its products. It covers product and category page optimization, site structure, product structured data, technical fixes like duplicate content and faceted navigation, and visibility in Google Shopping and AI shopping results.

cards.title: Duplicate & thin product pages
cards.text: Manufacturer descriptions, product variants and similar products create duplicate content that weakens rankings.

cards.title: Faceted navigation
cards.text: Filters for size, color and price can generate thousands of low-value URLs that waste crawl budget.

cards.title: Out-of-stock & discontinued products
cards.text: Handled badly, they create broken pages and lose rankings you've earned.

cards.title: Category pages that don't rank
cards.text: Category pages often target the most valuable searches but have no useful content.

cards.title: Category page optimization
cards.text: Helpful intro copy, internal links and structure built around search demand.

cards.title: Product page optimization
cards.text: Unique descriptions, titles, images and reviews.

cards.title: Product structured data
cards.text: Price, availability, reviews and shipping details for rich results.

cards.title: Faceted navigation & crawl control
cards.text: Canonicals, noindex rules and clean filter URLs.

ai.title: How do AI shopping tools find products?
ai.text: Google AI Mode, ChatGPT shopping features and Perplexity increasingly recommend products directly. They rely on structured product data, merchant feeds, reviews and clear product information.
ai.list_title: How we improve your AI shopping visibility:
items: Complete, accurate product data and feeds
Clear specs, sizing, materials and use cases on product pages
Buying guides and comparison content AI tools can reference

table.title: Shopify vs. WooCommerce for SEO
table.note: Both can rank well. The right choice depends on your catalog, team and growth plans.

items.question: How long does ecommerce SEO take?
items.answer: Technical fixes and product data improvements can show results within weeks. Category and content improvements usually take 3–6 months to build momentum.

items.question: Should I write unique product descriptions?
items.answer: Yes, especially for your best-selling and highest-margin products. Manufacturer descriptions appear on many sites, so unique descriptions help you stand out in search.

items.question: What should I do with out-of-stock products?
items.answer: Keep the page live if the product is coming back. If it's permanently discontinued, redirect it to the closest alternative or category.

items.question: Does Shopify have SEO limitations?
items.answer: Shopify is SEO-friendly, but it has a fixed URL structure and can create duplicate collection URLs. These are manageable with the right setup.

items.question: Can you help my products appear in Google Shopping?
items.answer: Yes. We set up and optimize Google Merchant Center so your products can appear in free Shopping listings.
